messages.subject: Ordering in factor not retained
parts:
Hi,

When I want to plot a factor, the ordering on the x(or y) axis is not
the same as the ordering in the factor. Example

> x <- c("LOW", "LOW", "HIGH", "LOW", "MEDIUM", "MEDIUM", "HIGH")
> y <- c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7)
> data <- data.frame(x,y)
# Apply ordering
> data$x <- ordered(data$x, level=c("LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH"))
> qplot(x,y, data=data)

Order is apparently LOW - HIGH - MEDIUM...

See also http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/scale_shape.html for an example
which doesn't work (ordering of shapes in the diamonds example)

I think this is since the release of 0.8.2

Christiaan Ypma
